name.label: Name
name.description: The string Blobatar turns into a shape. Can also be set from the plugin panel.

size.label: Avatar size
size.description: Rendered size in pixels. Higher is sharper, at the cost of a larger file.

background.label: Background
background.description: Shape drawn behind the blob. 'None' keeps the desktop visible through it.

gen.label: Generation
gen.description: Pins the name-to-blobatar mapping. A pinned generation never changes, so your pet stays the same shape forever.

lock_hue.label: Lock hue
lock_hue.description: Use a fixed colour instead of the one derived from the name.

lock_tone.label: Lock tone
lock_tone.description: Use a fixed tone instead of the one derived from the name.

reactions.label: Reactions
reactions.description: Let the expression follow battery, CPU, RAM, and do-not-disturb. When off the pet only reacts to the focus timer.

pomodoro_minutes.label: Focus length
pomodoro_minutes.description: Length of one focus session, in minutes.

notify.label: Notify
notify.description: Send a notification when a focus session finishes.

widget_size.label: Widget size
widget_size.description: Size of the blob on the desktop, in pixels.

animate.label: Animate
animate.description: Breathing motion, and a squash whenever the expression changes.

show_progress.label: Show focus bar
show_progress.description: Draw a progress bar under the blob during a focus session.

show_status.label: Show status
show_status.description: Show a one-line caption under the blob.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.description: Colour of the focus progress bar.

ui.offline_warning: Could not reach blobatar.dev. The pet keeps the last avatar it downloaded.
